input: Research sleep study clinics for chronic insomnia

gold.taskTitle: Research Sleep Study Clinics for Chronic Insomnia
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate sleep study clinics that specialize in diagnosing and treating chronic insomnia.

questions.title: Which city or region should the clinics be in?
questions.description: Determine the geographic location the user wants to search within.

questions.title: Is this research for yourself or someone else?
questions.description: Clarify who the patient is to tailor recommendations appropriately.

questions.title: Have you already seen a doctor about your insomnia?
questions.description: Understand whether a referral or prior diagnosis exists that might affect clinic options.

questions.title: What type of sleep study are you expecting to need?
questions.description: Determine if the user needs a full polysomnography, a home sleep test, or is unsure.

questions.title: Do you have health insurance that must be accepted?
questions.description: Identify insurance constraints that would filter which clinics are viable options.

questions.title: What is your timeline for booking an appointment?
questions.description: Understand urgency so the plan can prioritize availability and wait times.

questions.title: Are in-clinic overnight stays or at-home tests preferred?
questions.description: Clarify the user's comfort level or preference for the type of study setting.
